description: Judge whether a retraction propagates to a paper through its citation graph: retraction evidence is weighted by source tier, the citing context is checked for an acknowledgement, and the tool returns CONTESTED, SUPPORTED or ABSTAINED with the evidence path behind the verdict. Use it after integrity_paper_status when the question is "does this retraction reach this paper". It abstains instead of guessing when reference coverage is thin. Returns: verdict, confidence, the evidence path that produced it, and abstention details when the verdict is ABSTAINED. Paid: $0.02 per call (x402 on Base, POST /api/v1/judge); a keyed MCP session also unlocks it.

doi.description: DOI of the paper, e.g. 10.1016/S0140-6736(97)11096-0. Provide exactly one of doi or paper_id.

paper_id.description: OpenAlex work id, e.g. W2117847125. Provide exactly one of doi or paper_id.

name: retraction_propagation
